title: A counter-trend decline, the mirror of 18 Sep
why: Rule 1 downwards: MCD1 reports a sustained close below an uptrending M15 channel (COUNTER_TREND_EXPANSION) and MCD2 is a downtrend, so the Day Trader gets a SHORT (archetype C, COUNTER_TREND) and the MCD3 trend conflict is only a note, as 3.4 says for rule 1. The Scalper gets a SHORT with the M5 trend (rule 3s), and the same conflict makes its reading CAUTIONARY. The first zone's invalidation is raised to the $13 minimum (basis MINIMUM_STOP).
